description: Source code for the PinRepository class managing hardware pin usage and mapping in an embedded system firmware.

classes.name: PinRepository
classes.description: Class responsible for managing hardware pin usage, ensuring no conflicts, and providing pin mapping functions.

methods.name: getPortIndex
methods.description: Returns index of a given port.

methods.name: reportPins
methods.description: Reports all used pins and total count.

methods.name: parseBrainPin
methods.description: Parses string representation of a pin into an internal enum.

methods.name: hwPortname
methods.description: Returns string name of hardware port for a given pin.

methods.name: initPinRepository
methods.description: Initializes the pin repository, setting up data structures and console actions.

methods.name: getIndex
methods.description: Calculates index in PIN_USED array based on port and pin.

methods.name: markUsed
methods.description: Marks a pin as used with a message, returns true if already used.

methods.name: getPinFunction
methods.description: Retrieves the function or purpose assigned to a specific pin.
